quoted.text:
deploying persistent agents like Openclaw or Dots pose a major challenge for enterprise IT

agents are more like contractors than traditional saas software, able to take proactive actions in the background without human intervention
they are capable of fulfilling entire job functions but they can also take misaligned actions and write arbitrary code with unintended consequences

today, we are sharing some of the best practices we use to manage fleets of claws at @OpenAI 

https://t.co/4K6r8kQtMS
quoted.text_zh:
部署 Openclaw 或 Dots 这类持久化 agent，对企业 IT 来说是重大挑战。

这些 agent 更像承包商，而不是传统的 SaaS 软件，能够在没有人工干预的情况下在后台主动采取行动；它们有能力承担整份工作职能，但也可能采取偏离目标的行动，并写出带来意外后果的任意代码。

今天，我们分享了在 @OpenAI 管理一批 claws 时使用的一些最佳实践。

https://t.co/4K6r8kQtMS

quoted.text:
Added this hover [ 🎨 Style ] menu so you can preview styles very quickly in 3d

When you like one you press [ Render ] and you get the photorealistic version!

Next I wanna try if I can make it do a walkthrough in 3d and then pump that into a video model like Seedance to make it photoreal too

Then we'd have the holy grail, a full photorealistic walkthrough of your interior redesign 🤯
quoted.text_zh:
加了这个悬停 [ 🎨 Style ] 菜单，这样就能在 3D 里非常快速地预览各种风格

看中某个风格后按 [ Render ]，就能得到照片级效果！

下一步我想试试能不能先在 3D 里做一段走查，再把它送进 Seedance 这类视频模型，也做成照片级的

那就找到圣杯了：一段完整的、照片级的室内改造走查视频 🤯

posts.text:
All my feature dreams for Interior AI are coming true now :D

One idea I had was to let you upload your own wallpaper and set it, it was a pain to even get an image model to put that properly

With a 3d model it's much easier, so now you can walk around you room, upload a wallpaper texture and add it to any wall or object

And you can set the material of any object too

When you're done press [ ✨ Render ] and it becomes a photo!
posts.text_zh:
我为 Interior AI 设想的那些功能，现在都在实现了 :D

我曾有一个想法，是让你上传自己的壁纸并贴上去，但以前哪怕让图像模型把壁纸正确地贴上去都很痛苦

有了 3D 模型就容易多了，现在你可以在房间里走动，上传一张壁纸纹理，把它贴到任意墙面或物体上

你还可以设置任意物体的材质

弄完之后按 [ ✨ Render ]，它就会变成一张照片！

引用内容：他引用了自己稍早的帖子，介绍 Interior AI 新增的悬停 [ 🎨 Style ] 菜单，可在 3D 里快速预览风格，看中后按 [ Render ] 就能得到照片级效果；他还想把 3D 走查送进 Seedance 一类视频模型，做成完整的照片级室内改造走查视频。
